	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"

	"example.com/weather"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	// The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request.
	client, err := weather.NewWeatherClient(weather.Config{
		Token: func(context.Context) (string, error) { return os.Getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN"), nil },
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Values from the model's example "Read a city".
	input := &weather.GetCityInput{
		CityId: "c-0a1b2c3d",
		At:     weather.Some(time.Date(2026, time.January, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, time.UTC)),
	}

	output, err := client.GetCity(ctx, input)
	var notFoundError *weather.NotFoundError
	if errors.As(err, &notFoundError) {
		fmt.Printf("NotFoundError (HTTP %d): %v\n", notFoundError.Metadata.Metadata.Status, notFoundError.Message)
		return

	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(output.City)
	fmt.Println(output.GetForecast())
	fmt.Println(output.GetRequestId())
